facts.fact: The page states that there are two types of AI most important for marketers: predictive AI and generative AI.
facts.quote: There are two types of AI in marketing that are most important for you

facts.fact: According to Salesforce, predictive AI analyzes patterns in data to anticipate what outcome might happen next.
facts.quote: Predictive AI analyzes patterns in data to anticipate what outcome might happen next.

facts.fact: According to Salesforce, generative AI helps marketers create new content by creating new text and images based on patterns learned from its training data.
facts.quote: Generative AI helps marketers create new content by creating new text and images based on the patterns it has learned from the data it was trained on.

facts.fact: Salesforce describes marketing AI as using machine learning and deep learning to identify trends, make predictions, and perform digital tasks that would typically require human intelligence.
facts.quote: It uses machine learning and deep learning to identify trends, make predictions, and perform digital tasks that would typically require human intelligence and decision making.

facts.fact: Salesforce defines AI-driven retargeting as engaging the same customer multiple times with improved messaging.
facts.quote: AI can also help you with retargeting, which is when we engage with the same customer multiple times with improved messaging.

facts.fact: Salesforce states it is anticipated that generative AI will be able to produce more nuanced content, including videos, music, and images.
facts.quote: It’s anticipated that going forward, generative AI will be able to produce even more nuanced content, including videos, music, and images.

facts.fact: The page promises two real-world examples of companies successfully marketing with AI.
